Context: For those not entitled to 17 holidavs.s10 days.

Combining with EL.Officials who have got only half-day's Casual leave at credit, when applying for half-day's Casual Leave for the afternoon of a day should ensure that they attend office the next day, since Casual Leave cannot be combined with Earned Leave. However, if due to sickness or other compelling grounds, he is not able to attend the next day, combining with Earned leave can be permitted as an exception.
